searchText: Oh interesting Though I've also considered going in the other direction, limiting memory to 1 MB but not charging for it So the fastest the stack can grow is 32 bytes for 3 gas, so at 30M gas it could grow to ~300 MB if there is no limit and no other changes That's.... honestly not that bad What if we don't need a stack limit
